purpose: Required non-secret build arguments for external Worker CLI payloads; this template is not a release lock.
release_workflow: Stage reviewed payloads under deploy/worker-cli (ignored by Git).
Pass all four explicit SHA-256 build args to make worker-runtime-image-build.
Export the image-owned codify.worker.cli-artifacts/v1 document with make worker-cli-artifact-export.
Mount the exported immutable document read-only for Backend and Scheduler as CODIFY_WORKER_CLI_ARTIFACT_MANIFEST.
